name: Zainul Abedin
contribution: His famine sketches and later art practice established a socially engaged visual language in modern Bengal.
context: Working across late colonial and Pakistan-period East Bengal, he helped shape modern art education and public cultural institutions.
impact: He is remembered as a central architect of modern Bangladeshi art and visual memory.
highlight: Pioneer of modern art in Bengal and a witness-artist of social crisis.
seoTitle: Zainul Abedin: Pioneer of Modern Bangladeshi Art
seoDescription: Learn about Zainul Abedin’s famine sketches, socially engaged art, and role in building modern art education and cultural institutions in Bangladesh.
shortAnswer: Zainul Abedin was a pioneering Bengali artist whose famine sketches and institution-building shaped modern Bangladeshi art.
